title: Active recovery to target (controller TC04, closed loop, 12 h)
purpose: Patient stand-in starts at 35 degC (below t_hypo 36 degC): ACTIVE_WARMING after the 10 s dwell, PI warming at the 50 % channel cap, TARGET_MAINTENANCE at 24430 s (6.8 h) with low maintenance heat.
data_source: Controller: Suchitha's supervisory controller test TC04 (SIMULATED test bench, controller/neram_ctrl). Twin fields: test-bench stand-in values the controller received (SIMULATED).
loop_description: Closed loop with the ASSUMED patient plant and the twin stand-in.
limitations: Time to target (about 7 h) is a property of the ASSUMED plant gain; TC18 shows 3.6-13.9 h for 2x-0.5x gain. It is not a prediction.
Flat passive trajectory: no passive cooling is modelled.

Controller: Suchitha's supervisory controller design (v2 specification); Python fallback code rebuilt by Sai on 18 Oct 2026 from that specification (reproduces her v2 logs byte for byte). Not a Simulink/Stateflow model.

Twin fields are test-bench stand-ins (synthetic inputs or a first-order filter stand-in), NOT the NERAM twin. The forecast is the stand-in's flat persistence (T_pred = T_est) with normal bands from T_est_sd.
Hardware signals and module temperatures come from test stand-ins; no hardware exists. Thresholds are placeholders (Shreehan, TBD).
No clinical, hardware or treatment claim is made.
